'''Dewall Paez''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and leader of the [[Wayfar spies]].<ref name="SWG:JPBF" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the Wayfar spies were recruited by [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]], to spy on [[Romo Vax]]. Fortuna suspected Vax would try to double cross [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba's organization]]. However, Romo Vax managed to lure one of Bib Fortuna's henchman and made him assassinate Dewall Paez and some other Wayfar spies.<ref name="SWG:JPBF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dewall Paez appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JPBF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dewall Paez was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park|Jabba's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:JPBF" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
